article.story: BURLINGTON, Vt. -- — Will Davies scored 19 points as Vermont beat Brown 84-71 on Saturday. Davies shot 6 of 14 from the field, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 8 from the line for the Catamounts (3-3). Hayden Johns added 13 points while going 5 of 8 from the field and also had five rebounds. Khalil Badru shot 4 of 7 from the field and 4 for 6 from the line to finish with 12 points. Ray Cuevas led the Bears (2-5) in scoring, finishing with 17 points and six rebounds. Isaiah Langham added 12 points and seven rebounds for Brown. N’famara Dabo also had 11 points, 10 rebounds and four blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
